# Generated evidence: morpho/vault-v2-cap-accept

Written by `pnpm report morpho/vault-v2-cap-accept --vault-of acuto-usdc-v2-4a57 --record` from `templates/morpho/vault-v2-cap-accept/template.json`, `templates/morpho/vault-v2-cap-accept/docs.json`, `templates/morpho/vault-v2-cap-accept/vaults/acuto-usdc-v2-4a57/docs.json`, `registry/contracts.json`, `registry/markets.json`, `testdata/report/morpho-vault-v2-cap-accept/acuto-usdc-v2-4a57.json`, `testdata/abi`. The listings and pages were read on 2026-11-16. `pnpm test` computes it again from these files and fails on any difference: every section is recomputed from the recorded answers except the vault evidence, which is stored as `pnpm vault-evidence` printed it. The recordings were made on the AI's computer; `pnpm report morpho/vault-v2-cap-accept --vault-of acuto-usdc-v2-4a57 --compare` reads the listings, pages, ABI proofs, code spans, ERC-7730 attestations and DefiLlama's protocol entries and hacks live, reads each vault again at the blocks its evidence names and each protocol fact and token's decimals at the block it was read at, fetches each recorded past transaction again by hash, and prints each fact that differs. It does not search for past transactions again, so it cannot show that a search found every one. Text from outside the program appears only as identifiers: a contract name Sourcify gives, printed only when it is a Solidity identifier, and the file paths, field paths and format names `pnpm erc7730` prints. The URLs come from the registry and `docs.json`, in RFC 3986 characters only. Text the AI wrote appears only where a row says it was written by the AI in the template. Do not edit this file.

## Official documentation

Each page comes from `docs.json`, whose contract must be the one the template calls the function on when the template binds it. The program compares the page's registrable domain, or GitHub organization, with the DefiLlama protocol of that contract, checks that a GitHub page is pinned to a commit on the default branch, and looks in the page as served, without scripts, for the function's name written as code: directly followed by `(`, between backticks, or alone as a block, such as a heading, a list item or a table cell. A PASS there shows that the page names a function of that name, not that it documents this contract's function. A function a token standard defines may instead name that standard: its page, the GitHub org that publishes it and the function's declaration are held by the program, the page must hold that declaration, and its org is compared with the standard's, not with the contract's protocol. Such a PASS shows that the standard defines the function, not that this contract follows the standard.

## Code pins

Every span of each entry's registry code pin, oldest first: a span holds from its block to the block before the next span's. A transaction to sign must run the last span's code, and an executed one the code of the span that holds its block. `pnpm pin-code` writes the spans from the chain, not from a review of that code. Chain: whether, through both providers, the code at the span's first block is its pin, and the code at the block before is the previous span's pin, or for the first span, no code `pnpm pin-code` can pin. A lone pin from block 0 was written before ranges and is not read.

## Protocol facts

What DefiLlama and the chain say about the protocols this template's calls go to, other than a token's issuer, and the size of what each card field can name. They decide nothing, and `verify` never reads them. TVL is DefiLlama's estimate. DefiLlama's hacks list holds only what someone reported, and a hack counts here only when DefiLlama files it under the protocol's DefiLlama id or its parent's. Each view and `decimals()` is read through both providers at block 26428999 `0xeb9c41d50aa725d00fbc4abea714f7b7cbf9d35211d8718fe9ee7610fee676e4`; a read they do not agree on prints as not read.
